name: Gemcitabine + Docetaxel for Uterine Leiomyosarcoma
cyclesNote: the Hensley gemcitabine/docetaxel regimen does not print a fixed cycle count; continue per response and tolerance, physician determined (the 6-cycle figure in the GeDDiS trial used a lower gemcitabine dose)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The gemcitabine plus docetaxel doublet is a cytotoxic backbone for uterine leiomyosarcoma and is not biomarker restricted. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Uterine Neoplasms v3.2026, Systemic Therapy for Uterine Sarcoma (UTSARC-C).

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling to reduce fluid retention and hypersensitivity.

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support is required for this doublet per the source (DeVita line 176028, with G-CSF).
monitor for the occasional severe pulmonary toxicity noted with this combination (DeVita line 175823).
monitoring: pulmonary symptom assessment (rare severe pulmonary toxicity)
fluid retention / edema assessment for DOCEtaxel

doseModificationRules.text: Dose reductions of both drugs for patients with prior pelvic radiotherapy per the source (DeVita line 175835).

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC < 1500 or platelets < 100k on day 1 or day 8
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or delay per institutional protocol; physician decides.

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 176028 (Hensley regimen) and narrative line 175829. Gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 IV over 90 minutes on days 1 and 8, every 21 days, with growth factor support.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 176028 (Gemcitabine 900 mg/m2 over 90 min on days 1 and 8 + docetaxel 100 mg/m2 on day 8 with G-CSF q 21 d, Hensley et al.); narrative line 175829

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 176031 (Hensley regimen). DOCEtaxel 100 mg/m2 IV on day 8, every 21 days, with growth factor support. Source stated alternative: DOCEtaxel reduced to 75 mg/m2 (line 175835), with further reductions for patients with prior pelvic radiotherapy. Requires corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 176031 (docetaxel 100 mg/m2 on day 8 with G-CSF q 21 d, Hensley et al.); reduced dose alternative line 175835 (docetaxel 75 mg/m2)
